positive_observations: The repaired durable grant now budgets one initial implementation attempt and one initial task Review for each of the two admitted D1 tasks, keeps their repair budgets task-local, and expires only after aggregate D1 Review, so the dependent task no longer borrows authority from Task 1 repair capacity.

The final ACP/CLI Host boundary no longer owns launcher packet paths, while timeout, cancellation and writer-fence release all require matching complete-writer stop proof before a safe terminal result or another writer is admitted.

Task 2 now plans both its canonical ZCode execution packet and pre-dispatch attempt record, and treats dispatch as consuming the sole provider call before the request so an absent receipt cannot reopen the budget.
limitations: This delta lens verifies only the parent Review's P1 repair set in the frozen plan bytes; runtime implementation, process-tree behavior and the exact-Host denial observation remain for task execution and task Review.
The parent Review's retained P2 findings were not re-audited, promoted or repaired.
